AMENDEDANDRESTATEDZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENT AGREEMENT THIS AGREEMENT is entered into as of March 4, 2015, by and between TRINITY EPISCOPAL SCHOOL CORPORATION, a not-for-profit corporation having an office at 139 West 91st Street, New York, New York, 10024 ("School"); and TRINITY HOUSING COMPANY INC., a corporation organized and operating as a limited profit housing company pursuant to Article I of the New York Private Housing Finance Law, having an office at 100 West 92nd Street, New York, New York 10025 ("Housing"). School and Housing are hereinafter collectively defined as the“Declarants". WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, School is the owner of certain land ("School Premises"), together with the building and other improvements located thereon (together with any future replacements thereof and additions thereto permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, including the “New School Addition" (as defined below), the “School _Improvements"), in the City, County and State of New York, and known as Lots 17, 40 and 29 in Block 1222 on the Tax Map of the City and County of New York (the “Tax Map"), as more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the School Premises and the School Improvements, which includes the Garage Premises and the Garage Improvements, as hereinafter defined, being hereinafter referred to collectively as “School Property"); WHEREAS, Housing is the owner of (i) that certain parcel (the “Housing Premises"), together with the buildings and other improvements located thereon (together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, the "Housing Improvements” or the “Trinity House Building"), in the City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 9029 in Block 1222 on the Tax Map, and by the street address 100 West KL32977845.14
